lines.trans: Oh, guys, how well these new caps suit you!
You have such a strict, manly look now.
Vitya, I came into the dining room with a lady, cook something to eat.
Good afternoon, Dmitry Vladimirovich! I reviewed your orders.
You eat too much, I am reducing your discount.
What are you doing? I am the face of this restaurant!
Precisely, you are the face of this restaurant, not its stomach.
Andrey, he humiliated me right in front of my cooks!

Then let us do this: I will buy back this restaurant!
